note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; participants, parties, turns and the substituted values are as supplied. A pending turn only means waiting; no preset infers an order, validity, time per turn or consequence.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Participant A holds the turn signal; the card in front of Participant C reads “Turn: pending (waiting, as supplied)” and is substituted by “Turn: active (as supplied)”: the signal is passed to C and C’s lamp lights.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a wording substitution on the other side of the table — Participant B holds the signal and the card in front of Participant D changes from “Card: turn requested (as supplied)” to “Card: turn pending (as supplied)”; nothing moves.
